attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-cave-bear-wood-v2".

Subject and threat:
- Species: cave-bear.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: close-range-bruiser.
- Construction mode: organic-quadruped.

Identity invariants:
- recognizable ursine face
- heavy shoulder mass
- powerful forelimbs

Anatomy invariants:
- ursine anatomy
- exactly four legs
- four-legged weight distribution
- all four paws are separately readable with visible ground contact and no hind-paw occlusion

Affinity: wood.
Affinity expression: bark grain, load-bearing roots, resin seams, wooden articulation, and purposeful living growth
Counterplay cue: Resin-bright binding joints or fresh-cut growth expose the interruptible structure.
Altered dimensions: material; anatomy; equipment; exposed-counterplay.
Permitted transformations: material; localized anatomy; equipment; counterplay cue.
Prohibited traits: wolf proportions; humanoid golem anatomy; decorative saddle or rider; a brown recolor, decorative antlers, or foliage pasted over the silhouette; overlapping legs or stance that hides either hind paw.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one full-body Wood Cave Bear in a grounded broadside-to-three-quarter stance, with staggered legs and all four paws independently visible; every root tip and extremity remains inside the inner eighty-four percent of the finished canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/experiments/affinity-workflow-v1/candidates/cave-bear/wood-v1.png — Previous Wood Cave Bear candidate supplies the retained ursine identity and load-bearing wood design; preserve those cues while changing the stance so all four paws are independently visible.
2. assets/enemies/review/beasts-v1.webp — Third subject only: established Cave Bear anatomy, coat, grounded mass, and shoulder weight; do not transfer either wolf or the Tunnel Boar.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
